lesson.title: Review Day: Introduction to Literary Analysis
lesson.subject: ela

contentBlocks.text: This week you analyzed two stories closely. Let's review everything you learned!

Quick review: literary analysis looks at HOW a story is told, and theme is its lesson or message (Day 1). You found the kite story's theme (Day 2). You supported that theme with real evidence from the text (Day 3). You compared it to a different theme in the Marcus story (Day 4). Answer: what is theme, and name one piece of evidence that supported a theme this week.
Wonderful work this week — you did real literary analysis, finding themes and supporting them with evidence! Next week we'll build on these skills with something new.

objectives: Review theme, evidence-based support, and comparing themes across texts
Define theme and recall one real piece of supporting evidence from this week
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Do the quick walk-through review of all 4 days together, out loud.
2. Have the child answer both review questions.
3. Complete the review worksheet.
4. Celebrate finishing a full week of literary analysis!
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus on just one of the two review questions, whichever the child engaged with most this week
Ready for more: ask the child what other themes they might expect to find in future stories this course explores
This is a good checkpoint to note which of the week's four skills (defining theme, finding it, evidence, or comparison) needs the most reinforcement before the next literary-analysis unit
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a recall and review activity — check that the child can define theme as a story's lesson/message and correctly recall one real piece of supporting evidence from either story this week.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Consolidates this week's Common Core Grade 4 Reading standards (RL.4.1/RL.4.2/RL.4.9) before the course continues, matching the established Day-5-review pacing used across every unit this session.

generationData.instructions: Answer each question to review this week.
